result.question: Qual a média móvel de 3 anos de internações no estado do RS por ano (2008-2023)?
result.gold_sql: SELECT ano, total_internacoes, ROUND(AVG(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS media_movel_3anos FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ano) sub ORDER BY ano;
result.generated_sql: WITH internacoes_por_ano AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, AVG(i."VAL_TOT") AS media FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" WHERE mu."estado" = 'RS' AND i."DT_INTER" BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY ano ), media_movel AS ( SELECT ano, total_internacoes, media, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ano) AS rn FROM internacoes_por_ano ) SELECT ano, AVG(media) OVER (ORDER BY ano ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS media_movel_3_anos, SUM(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total_internacoes_3_anos FROM media_movel ORDER BY ano;
